Refuted as stated; the corrected claim below keeps what survives.
corrected_claim: The head place pages do collect Google impressions but sit on pages 3-5 with zero clicks: direct GSC API 2026-07-28..2026-09-19 shows /cities/bend 866 impr pos 39.2 (site's #10 page), /cities/redmond 703 @ 31.3, /communities/tetherow 577 @ 38.8, /communities/northwest-crossing 148 @ 27.3, /communities/sunriver 143 @ 47.6, /communities/brasada-ranch 1,408 @ 32.9, all 0-1 clicks. Only /cities/bend/awbrey-butte has zero impressions in 8 weeks despite being live 200 index,follow self-canonical. Of the 12 target queries, 'sunriver homes for sale' (276 impr, pos 48.7, landing split: /cities/sunriver 193 vs /communities/sunriver 28) and 'redmond oregon homes for sale' (23 impr, pos 34.4) DO produce rows; the queries with no API row in the window are 'awbrey butte homes for sale', 'best neighborhoods in bend oregon', 'bend oregon real estate agents' and 'ryan realty bend'. WebSearch shows ryan-realty.com on none of the sampled non-brand queries while cascadehasson.com / bendrealestate.com / bendpremierrealestate.com / enjoybendlife.com do. The loop's benchmark view (target_query_benchmark) cannot see any of this because it is a view over the 25-row-per-day site_signal ingest (search-console-report.ts rowLimit 25); the growth-loop measurer already reads the uncapped API (scripts/_gsc-place-pages.mjs, seed-gsc-ranking-queue.ts landed 2026-09-22) but the ranking seeds have not been applied (0 'GSC gap' nodes) and site-queue-done.ts has no GSC field.
corrected_fix: Do not build a new GSC-position field from scratch; the uncapped pull and per-query accept text already exist in scripts/seed-gsc-ranking-queue.ts (landed 2026-09-22, never applied). (1) Raise the site_signal ingest cap or add a per-target-query filtered pull so target_query_benchmark stops reporting absence for queries that have hundreds of impressions (search-console-report.ts rowLimit 25 -> a filtered query for every target_queries row, or rowLimit 1000). (2) Run seed-gsc-ranking-queue.ts --apply so the 'missing-p1' and 'cannibal' nodes exist, and wire the 28-day GSC accept it already writes into lib/data/loop/site-queue-done.ts so a node cannot close without the query x page re-pull. (3) Investigate /cities/bend/awbrey-butte specifically (zero impressions in 8 weeks on a live index,follow page; site: search surfaces only legacy Awbrey URLs) with a URL inspection rather than prose changes. (4) Resolve the Sunriver landing split (/cities/sunriver vs /communities/sunriver vs /communities/sunriver-river-view) per PAGE_OUTLINE one-winner before adding prose. (5) Any bylined guide block must be prose the named broker actually wrote or approved (CLAUDE.md section 2: real quotes), and the community page file is under the SITE-162 edit lock, so route it through a node rather than a direct edit. Keep the blog guides as linked spokes; do not 301 a page-1 guide onto a pos-40 hub without a merged body and a dated rollback (COMP-1 territory).
